method: PDG Highland scattering with Gluckstern intrinsic term
beta_source: derived from rigidity, charge and mass
mdr_definition: rigidity where the total sigma(R)/R reaches 1 (scattering and intrinsic terms)
warnings: 8 measuring layers: the Gluckstern term (stated for N >= 10) overstates the intrinsic term by 2.4% against the exact fit of 8 equally spaced points (intrinsic_coefficient); for the actual layer positions use tracker_resolution.py momentum
note: Design-level estimate assuming equally spaced measuring layers and a uniform field; it does not replace a full track fit.
